title: Cube designer - Facts & Measures - default measure

criteria.given: a canvas cube whose default measure is set to a measure the cube exposes
criteria.then: the Mondrian 4 exporter emits that measure as the defaultMeasure attribute on the cube's <Cube> element, and omits the attribute when the named measure no longer exists on the cube

criteria.given: a Mondrian 4 schema whose <Cube> carries a defaultMeasure attribute
criteria.then: the importer reads it onto the imported workbench cube so it survives a round-trip

criteria.given: an imported schema with a defaultMeasure
criteria.then: the workbench seed mapping carries it onto the doc cube so the inspector can edit it and re-export it

criteria.given: a cube root node selected in the designer's Properties inspector
criteria.then: the <Cube> properties panel offers a default-measure select listing the cube's measures, with an empty option that clears the setting
it exposes a setDefaultMeasure mutator on the doc cube, and the workbench write-back (setCubes) preserves an existing defaultMeasure like it already preserves timeCalcs
